scope: Source review and public-development fixtures only. No fresh cohort generation, fitting, forecast scoring, or held response reads.
verified: All five development prediction identities bind their exact recipe plan before any prediction/target array access; unavailable extended run binds its failed terminal budget plan.
Native graph recovery, calibration-selected recipe, selector source and public metadata are bound to expected plans and evidence hashes.
Independent missing-commit and foreign-plan fixtures stop before any private target read.

Cohort export validates world/calibration role/n4/dt25us/protocol/freeze identity before arrays; only calibration trajectory enters oracle track export, with 98 tracked and 27 known initial interior points and no hidden material fields.
Both public forecast setups retain declared 40mm/80mm floors and .30s duration; failed calibration world remains unavailable rather than replaced.

Sampled surface diagnostics use oriented closed triangles, rest-area surface centroid, recorded-clock contact and censored apex. They explicitly do not certify interior J, true mass COM, impulse or continuum penetration.

Shared fitter accepts only exact original 54 forward catalogue tasks with source/checkpoint/physics/query/clock/status/file hashes; it recomputes each world loss rather than reusing old scores or selected parameters.

Both categorical families receive 24 coarse and 32 fine bounded Powell evaluations, neutral fixed catalogue starts, identical visible-prefix loss and n3 candidate selection. Optimizer success is distinct from search completion.

Public runtime manifest is rechecked by workers; failed/unavailable worlds and incomplete family searches are retained. Forecast wrapper emits explicit terminal failures for unavailable parameter commits.
Original Torch2.14.1 and NumPy2.5.4 runtime is enforced for catalogue-compatible fitting and forecasting.
limitations: Fresh final method_recipe, full source/input closure, exact immutable protocol/freeze and independent launch approval remain required; this source audit alone does not authorize generation.
Development scorer still waits all five commits including fine forecast; no current private forecast outcome was read.
The fresh cohort uses noiseless oracle tracked positions with raster visibility, not end-to-end video reconstruction.
Finite-resolution n4 teacher and n3 fitter are explicitly different approximations; spatial sensitivity and failures must remain in final interpretation.
